scope: Two shapes separately validate same-shape C/P0 hot costs: NI1 singleton and actual NI1+NI46 batch, full T1201, 2 or 4 physical endpoint rows. No NI1x2 stand-in for serial NI1+46 and no direct B2/B1 matched batch-speed ratio. All warm, initialization and failed expenses remain explicit. Structural input/target pairing checks and NI1 cross-shape numeric comparisons are audited; NI46 has no new singleton or swapped-batch control. No score calls means no new batch RISE/MAS or general batch-quality verdict.

precision_and_backend_scope.native_precision: Original BF16 model/FA and established FP32 finite coefficient/logprob rules, unchanged pinned source and weight receipts; no new precision experiment or repair.
precision_and_backend_scope.PV_content0_API_limit: This endpoint swap is a PV content0 selection only for the current endpoint-symmetric logarithmic-mean softmax and QK finite-FA backend. For a future asymmetric supported-secant backend it would also reverse the Jacobian endpoint. It is not a generic backend-independent PV switch.
precision_and_backend_scope.two_observation_cost_limit: Per shape and method, two hot observations are descriptive; no guaranteed speedup, universal quality winner or unequal-length batch acceptance.

study_cost_scope: Two independent shapes: NI1 singleton (2 endpoint rows) and NI1+NI46 distinct batch (4 rows). Each has C/P0 warm then C/P0/P0/C measured. Only same-shape same-sample method costs are compared; no NI1x2 proxy for serial NI1+46, and no direct B2/B1 batching speed claim. Full outerattribute time includes native head/checkpoints,endpoint copies,allFA/FLA/conv and existingstage synchronizations; packing/CPU audit/persistence are outside it and retained in group/total wall. All warm, failed, initialization, callback and memory costs remain in receipts. Two observations per method/shape; no general speed guarantee.
